name: Cloudflare Tunnel
description: Zero-port-forwarding HTTPS tunnel (Quick Tunnel *.trycloudflare.com or Named Zero Trust Tunnel) for remote access to Mainsail/Fluidd without requiring a kernel TUN device.
author: Cloudflare, Inc.

changes: Package static MIPS32el build of cloudflared v2026.9.3 for RosetteOS
Default to instant zero-config Quick Tunnel (*.trycloudflare.com -> http://127.0.0.1:80) or persistent Zero Trust tunnel token via cloudflared.env
Add CLOUDFLARED_STATUS, CLOUDFLARED_QUICK_TUNNEL, CLOUDFLARED_SET_TOKEN, and CLOUDFLARED_RESTART Klipper macros
